rv.q: Directors Jim Corti and Creg Sclavi have created an amazing night of theatre not to be missed.
They all come together to deliver a musical experience as electric as Perkins' guitar.

Aurora Mayor Richard Irvin’s exclamation at the conclusion of Stolp Island Theatre’s inaugural production of “Million Dollar Quartet” summarized perfectly the press preview audience’s rapturous response to this irresistible celebration of rock ’n’ roll in all its raw, primal, original glory.
Their inaugural production of MILLION DOLLAR QUARTET is a polished, professionally performed show that’s also a warm tribute to four of America’s best loved musicians.
It’s great to hear Sun music sound so vibrant.
You don't want to miss this one!!!

cn.t: Critics praise this raucous, richly entertaining production that rocks the intimate new Stolp Island Theatre with fantastic performances capturing the historic 1956 meeting of Elvis, Cash, Perkins and Lewis.
